+"""TC-P6-MON-001..012: cost aggregation, pricing phase, percentiles."""
+
+from datetime import datetime
+from decimal import Decimal
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+
+import pytest
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import UsageSource
+from tradingagents.cost.monitor import CostMonitor, nearest_rank, price_phase
+from tradingagents.cost.report import compute_report_coverage
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit
+
+
+def _report(monitor, budget):
+    return monitor.report("run-1", budget, quality_floor_pass=True)
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_001_aggregates_by_agent(make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-001: per-agent token totals are correct."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(make_event(agent_name="market", prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens=5, total_tokens=15))
+    monitor.record(make_event(agent_name="news", prompt_tokens=20, completion_tokens=10, total_tokens=30))
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert report.by_agent["market"] == 15
+    assert report.by_agent["news"] == 30
+    assert report.total_tokens == 45
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_002_aggregates_by_model(make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-002: per-model token totals and costs are correct."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(make_event(model="model-a", prompt_tokens=10, completion_tokens=5, total_tokens=15))
+    monitor.record(make_event(model="model-b", prompt_tokens=20, completion_tokens=10, total_tokens=30))
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert report.by_model["model-a"] == 15
+    assert report.by_model["model-b"] == 30
+    assert report.total_tokens == 45
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_003_retry_tokens_are_included(make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-003: retry tokens count toward the run total."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(
+        make_event(
+            retry_count=2,
+            prompt_tokens=10,
+            completion_tokens=5,
+            total_tokens=15,
+        )
+    )
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert report.total_tokens == 15
+    assert report.by_agent["market"] == 15
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_004_cost_math_uses_phase_and_cache_miss(
+    make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget
+):
+    """TC-P6-MON-004: cost = input*cache_miss + output, divided by 1M."""
+    peak = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 10, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
+    off_peak = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 20, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(
+        make_event(
+            timestamp=peak,
+            prompt_tokens=1_000_000,
+            completion_tokens=1_000_000,
+            total_tokens=2_000_000,
+        )
+    )
+    monitor.record(
+        make_event(
+            timestamp=off_peak,
+            prompt_tokens=1_000_000,
+            completion_tokens=1_000_000,
+            total_tokens=2_000_000,
+        )
+    )
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    # model-a: peak 2+8=10 CNY; off-peak 1+4=5 CNY.
+    assert report.cost == Decimal("15")
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_005_missing_usage_falls_back(make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-005: estimated usage still produces a report."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(
+        make_event(
+            usage_source=UsageSource.ESTIMATED,
+            prompt_tokens=10,
+            completion_tokens=5,
+            total_tokens=15,
+        )
+    )
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert report.total_tokens == 15
+    assert report.by_agent["market"] == 15
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_006_price_table_provenance(make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-006: reports pin the price table version and source."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(make_event())
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert report.price_table_version == synthetic_price_table.version
+    assert report.price_table_source == synthetic_price_table.source_url
+    assert report.currency == "CNY"
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_007_report_coverage():
+    """TC-P6-MON-007: coverage is the fraction of runs with a report."""
+    assert compute_report_coverage({"r1", "r2"}, {"r1", "r2"}) == 1.0
+    assert compute_report_coverage({"r1", "r2"}, {"r1"}) == 0.5
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_008_empty_event_set(synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-008: an empty run produces zeros, not an exception."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert report.total_tokens == 0
+    assert report.cost == Decimal("0")
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_009_nearest_rank_percentile():
+    """TC-P6-MON-009: p50/p95 use nearest-rank, not interpolation."""
+    values = list(range(1, 101))
+
+    assert nearest_rank(values, 0.50) == 50
+    assert nearest_rank(values, 0.95) == 95
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_010_price_phase_weekday_and_weekend(shanghai):
+    """TC-P6-MON-010: peak is 09-12 and 14-18 on weekdays; weekends are off-peak."""
+    assert price_phase(datetime(2026, 11, 16, 9, 0, tzinfo=shanghai)) == "peak"
+    assert price_phase(datetime(2026, 11, 16, 12, 0, tzinfo=shanghai)) == "off_peak"
+    assert price_phase(datetime(2026, 11, 16, 14, 0, tzinfo=shanghai)) == "peak"
+    assert price_phase(datetime(2026, 11, 16, 18, 0, tzinfo=shanghai)) == "off_peak"
+    assert price_phase(datetime(2026, 11, 14, 10, 0, tzinfo=shanghai)) == "off_peak"
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_011_peak_costs_more_than_off_peak(
+    make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget
+):
+    """TC-P6-MON-011: identical tokens cost more in the peak phase."""
+    peak = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 10, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
+    off_peak = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 20, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
+
+    peak_monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    peak_monitor.record(make_event(timestamp=peak, prompt_tokens=1000, completion_tokens=1000, total_tokens=2000))
+    off_peak_monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    off_peak_monitor.record(make_event(timestamp=off_peak, prompt_tokens=1000, completion_tokens=1000, total_tokens=2000))
+
+    assert _report(peak_monitor, budget).cost > _report(off_peak_monitor, budget).cost
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_012_holidays_are_ignored(make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget):
+    """TC-P6-MON-012: a weekday holiday is still priced by weekday hours."""
+    holiday_peak = datetime(2026, 10, 1, 10, 0, tzinfo=ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai"))
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(make_event(timestamp=holiday_peak, prompt_tokens=1000, completion_tokens=1000, total_tokens=2000))
+
+    report = _report(monitor, budget)
+
+    assert price_phase(holiday_peak) == "peak"
+    assert report.peak_policy == "weekday_hours_ignore_holidays"
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_mon_013_reports_are_isolated_by_run_id(
+    make_event, synthetic_price_table, budget
+):
+    """TC-P6-MON-013: a shared monitor must not leak events across runs."""
+    monitor = CostMonitor(synthetic_price_table)
+    monitor.record(
+        make_event(
+            run_id="r1",
+            prompt_tokens=10,
+            completion_tokens=5,
+            total_tokens=15,
+        )
+    )
+    monitor.record(
+        make_event(
+            run_id="r2",
+            prompt_tokens=20,
+            completion_tokens=10,
+            total_tokens=30,
+        )
+    )
+
+    r1 = monitor.report("r1", budget, quality_floor_pass=True)
+    r2 = monitor.report("r2", budget, quality_floor_pass=True)
+
+    assert r1.total_tokens == 15
+    assert r2.total_tokens == 30
+    assert r1.by_agent["market"] == 15
+    assert r2.by_agent["market"] == 30

+"""TC-P6-RTR-001..009: budget routing and protected evidence."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import RoutePath
+from tradingagents.cost.router import (
+    route,
+    route_after_summary,
+    select_cheaper_model,
+    summarize_context,
+)
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.unit
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_001_within_soft_goes_direct(budget):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-001: under the soft limit, call directly."""
+    decision = route(10, budget)
+
+    assert decision.route_path is RoutePath.DIRECT
+    assert decision.estimated_tokens == 10
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_002_between_soft_and_hard_summarizes(budget):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-002: between soft and hard, summarize first."""
+    decision = route(90, budget)
+
+    assert decision.route_path is RoutePath.SUMMARIZE
+    assert decision.estimated_tokens == 90
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_003_over_hard_fails_fast(budget):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-003: over the hard cap, stop before any provider call."""
+    decision = route(101, budget)
+
+    assert decision.route_path is RoutePath.HARD_FAIL
+    assert decision.estimated_tokens == 101
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_004_summary_preserves_protected_evidence():
+    """TC-P6-RTR-004: summarization never drops decision-critical evidence."""
+    context = {
+        "market_snapshot": "NVDA close=168.89; rsi=23.95",
+        "evidence_refs": ["market_snapshot:abc", "news:123"],
+        "risk_constraints": ["max 1% account risk"],
+        "rating_inputs": {"rating": "Sell"},
+        "news_text": "long news " * 200,
+    }
+    protected = {
+        "market_snapshot",
+        "evidence_refs",
+        "risk_constraints",
+        "rating_inputs",
+    }
+
+    summary = summarize_context(context, protected_keys=protected)
+
+    for key in protected:
+        assert summary[key] == context[key]
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_005_route_records_path_and_reason(budget):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-005: route decisions are auditable."""
+    decision = route(90, budget)
+
+    assert decision.route_path is RoutePath.SUMMARIZE
+    assert isinstance(decision.reason, str) and decision.reason
+    assert decision.estimated_tokens == 90
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_006_over_hard_is_not_silent(budget):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-006: hard failure is explicit, never a silent overrun."""
+    decision = route(101, budget)
+
+    assert decision.route_path is RoutePath.HARD_FAIL
+    assert "budget" in decision.reason.lower() or "hard" in decision.reason.lower()
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_007_after_summary_uses_cheaper_model(budget):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-007: if summarization is still above soft, try a cheaper model."""
+    assert route_after_summary(10, budget).route_path is RoutePath.DIRECT
+    assert route_after_summary(90, budget).route_path is RoutePath.CHEAPER_MODEL
+    assert route_after_summary(101, budget).route_path is RoutePath.HARD_FAIL
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_008_summary_reduces_context():
+    """TC-P6-RTR-008: summarization must actually reduce the context."""
+    context = {
+        "market_snapshot": "NVDA close=168.89",
+        "news_text": "long news " * 500,
+    }
+
+    summary = summarize_context(context, protected_keys={"market_snapshot"})
+
+    assert summary["market_snapshot"] == context["market_snapshot"]
+    assert len(str(summary["news_text"])) < len(str(context["news_text"]))
+
+
+def test_tc_p6_rtr_009_cheaper_model_is_actually_cheaper(synthetic_price_table):
+    """TC-P6-RTR-009: cheaper_model selects a lower-priced allowed model."""
+    selected = select_cheaper_model(
+        "model-a",
+        price_table=synthetic_price_table,
+        allowed_models={"model-a", "model-b"},
+    )
+
+    assert selected == "model-b"
+    assert (
+        synthetic_price_table.models[selected].off_peak.input_cache_miss_per_1m
+        < synthetic_price_table.models["model-a"].off_peak.input_cache_miss_per_1m
+    )

@@ -0,0 +1,13 @@
+## 如何新增一个 DebateTurn 字段
+
+1. 在 `tradingagents/contracts/debate.py` 的 `DebateTurn` 中定义字段、类型、默认值与约束。这是唯一的字段定义来源；`schemas.py` 只重新导出，无需复制字段或修改 `contracts/__init__.py`。
+2. `prompts.py` 从契约生成 JSON Schema。新增字段后，核对 Bull / Bear 提示仍要求输出完整的单个 JSON 对象；若新增必填字段，同步补齐 `adapter.py` 中 `invalid` 占位对象的值。涉及历史关系的约束放在 `validator.py`，涉及质量计算的口径放在 `quality.py`。
+3. 同步验证契约测试、协议测试和质量测试，覆盖正常发言、首次失败后重试、再次失败后的完整占位对象。固定样本统一使用 `tests/fixtures/debate/`，并按测试审批范围处理后续样本变更。
+
+## 如何调整收敛判断
+
+在 `convergence.py` 的 `should_stop(transcript, max_rounds)` 中调整规则。当前达到 `2 * max_rounds` 次发言即停止；提前停止要求至少已有两个完整的 Bull / Bear 轮次，最新一轮双方均 `no_new_evidence=true`，且双方各自的 `stance` 与自己上一轮相同。单方刚发言时不提前停止，`invalid` 发言不参与收敛。
+
+修改后用 `test_convergence_fixtures` 核对现有 `convergence.json`，并用 `test_max_rounds` 核对永不收敛、最大轮数为 2 时恰好 4 次发言。路由接入点是 `conditional_logic.py` 的 `should_continue_debate()`，返回值保持 `Bull Researcher`、`Bear Researcher`、`Research Manager`；关闭结构化辩论或没有结构化发言时沿用原来的计数上限。
+
+重复主张指标由 `quality.py` 计算：先 casefold、统一连续空白和 Unicode 标点，再进行相等或标准库相似度比较。相似度常量 `CLAIM_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD` 为 **0.95**，重复主张率验收阈值为 **≤ 0.10**。调整时同步更新代码注释与质量边界断言，并核对固定样本的确定性结果。

@@ -0,0 +1,135 @@
+"""结构化发言适配层：调用、JSON 解析、一次修复重试与无效占位。"""
+
+import json
+from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+from tradingagents.agents.context import (
+    get_instrument_context_from_state,
+    get_language_instruction,
+    opponent_argument_or_opening,
+    report_or_absent,
+)
+
+from .prompts import BEAR_PROMPT, BULL_PROMPT
+from .schemas import DebateTurn, Stance
+from .stubs import sanitize
+from .validator import validate_turn, validate_turns
+
+
+def _response_text(response: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(response, str):
+        return response
+    content = (
+        response.get("content")
+        if isinstance(response, Mapping)
+        else getattr(response, "content", None)
+    )
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        return content
+    raise ValueError("completion must return text or an object with text content")
+
+
+def _build_prompt(state, debate, speaker, previous, round_number, turn_id):
+    opponent = "bear analyst" if speaker == "bull" else "bull analyst"
+    current_response = debate.get("current_response", "")
+    if not current_response and previous:
+        current_response = previous[-1].claim
+    history = debate.get("history", "") or json.dumps(
+        [turn.model_dump(mode="json") for turn in previous], ensure_ascii=False
+    )
+    instrument = (
+        get_instrument_context_from_state(state)
+        if "company_of_interest" in state
+        else state.get("instrument_context", "")
+    )
+    context = "\n".join(
+        (
+            str(instrument),
+            f"Asset type: {state.get('asset_type', 'stock')}",
+            "Market research report: " + report_or_absent(state.get("market_report", ""), "market"),
+            "Social media sentiment report: "
+            + report_or_absent(state.get("sentiment_report", ""), "sentiment"),
+            "Latest world affairs news: " + report_or_absent(state.get("news_report", ""), "news"),
+            "Fundamentals report: "
+            + report_or_absent(state.get("fundamentals_report", ""), "fundamentals"),
+            "Conversation history of the debate: " + history,
+            "Last opponent argument: " + opponent_argument_or_opening(current_response, opponent),
+        )
+    )
+    parameters = {
+        "turn_id": turn_id,
+        "round": round_number,
+        "speaker": speaker,
+        "previous_turn_ids": [turn.turn_id for turn in previous],
+    }
+    return sanitize(
+        "\n\n".join(
+            (
+                BULL_PROMPT if speaker == "bull" else BEAR_PROMPT,
+                context,
+                "本次发言参数：\n" + json.dumps(parameters, ensure_ascii=False),
+                "round 和 speaker 必须与本次参数一致；turn_id 必须在历史中唯一。",
+                get_language_instruction(),
+            )
+        )
+    )
+
+
+def run_debate_turn(
+    state: Mapping[str, Any], speaker: str, complete: Callable[[str], Any]
+) -> DebateTurn:
+    """最多调用 complete 两次；模型失败返回占位，不直接修改 state。"""
+    if speaker not in ("bull", "bear"):
+        raise ValueError("speaker must be bull or bear")
+    debate = state.get("investment_debate_state", {})
+    previous = validate_turns(debate.get("turns", []))
+    round_number = max(debate.get("count", 0), previous[-1].round if previous else 0) + 1
+    turn_id = f"{speaker}-{round_number}"
+    existing_ids = {turn.turn_id for turn in previous}
+    suffix = 1
+    while turn_id in existing_ids:
+        turn_id = f"{speaker}-{round_number}-{suffix}"
+        suffix += 1
+    prompt = _build_prompt(state, debate, speaker, previous, round_number, turn_id)
+    retry_prompt = prompt + (
+        "\n\n上次输出未通过 JSON 或辩论契约校验。"
+        "请重新输出完整的单个 JSON 对象，保持本次 round、speaker 和已有引用约束。"
+    )
+    for attempt in range(2):
+        try:
+            text = _response_text(complete(prompt if attempt == 0 else retry_prompt))
+            payload = json.loads(text)
+            if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+                raise ValueError("completion must contain one JSON object")
+            turn = validate_turn(
+                payload,
+                previous,
+                expected_speaker=speaker,
+                expected_round=round_number,
+            )
+            if turn.status != "ok":
+                raise ValueError("completion reported an invalid turn")
+            return turn
+        except Exception:
+            # 不记录模型原文或异常原文，也不把它们复制进重试提示。
+            continue
+
+    return DebateTurn(
+        turn_id=turn_id,
+        round=round_number,
+        speaker=speaker,
+        claim="本轮结构化发言不可用，请由 Research Manager 基于已有内容总结。",
+        stance=Stance.NEUTRAL,
+        evidence_refs=[],
+        assumptions=[],
+        rebuttal_to=None,
+        confidence=0.0,
+        open_questions=[],
+        requested_evidence=[],
+        no_new_evidence=True,
+        status="invalid",
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["run_debate_turn"]

@@ -0,0 +1,29 @@
+"""研究辩论的最大轮数与完整双方轮次收敛判断。"""
+
+from .validator import validate_turns
+
+
+def should_stop(transcript, max_rounds: int) -> bool:
+    """达到上限停止；早停必须比较相邻两个完整双方轮次。"""
+    if isinstance(max_rounds, bool) or not isinstance(max_rounds, int) or max_rounds < 0:
+        raise ValueError("max_rounds must be a nonnegative integer")
+    turns = validate_turns(transcript)
+    if len(turns) >= 2 * max_rounds:
+        return True
+    # 只有双方都完成当前轮次，且各自都有上一轮立场可比较时才考虑收敛。
+    if len(turns) < 4 or len(turns) % 2:
+        return False
+    previous, latest = turns[-4:-2], turns[-2:]
+    if {turn.speaker for turn in previous} != {"bull", "bear"}:
+        return False
+    if {turn.speaker for turn in latest} != {"bull", "bear"}:
+        return False
+    if any(turn.status != "ok" for turn in previous + latest):
+        return False
+    if not all(turn.no_new_evidence for turn in latest):
+        return False
+    previous_stances = {turn.speaker: turn.stance for turn in previous}
+    return all(turn.stance == previous_stances[turn.speaker] for turn in latest)
+
+
+__all__ = ["should_stop"]

+"""将有序 Transcript 导出为普通字典，不写文件。"""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping
+
+from .schemas import DebateTranscript, DebateTurn
+from .validator import validate_turns
+
+
+def export_transcript(transcript) -> dict:
+    """按 round 排序并重新验证，保留 transcript_id 与质量可用性。"""
+    if isinstance(transcript, DebateTranscript):
+        payload = transcript.model_dump(mode="python")
+    elif isinstance(transcript, Mapping):
+        payload = dict(transcript)
+    else:
+        raise ValueError("transcript must be a DebateTranscript or mapping")
+    turns = [
+        DebateTurn.model_validate(
+            turn.model_dump(mode="python") if isinstance(turn, DebateTurn) else turn
+        )
+        for turn in payload.get("turns", [])
+    ]
+    payload["turns"] = validate_turns(sorted(turns, key=lambda turn: turn.round))
+    return DebateTranscript.model_validate(payload).model_dump(mode="json")
+
+
+__all__ = ["export_transcript"]

+

+rebuttal_to 只能引用历史中已经存在的 turn_id；开场发言使用 null。
+evidence_refs 只使用本次实际提供的字符串引用，例如 "market:price"。

+confidence 必须是 0 到 1 之间的数字；stance 只能是 bullish、bearish、neutral。
+status 通常为 ok；无法给出有效发言时可标记 invalid，不能伪造支持证据。
+""".strip()
+
+_SCHEMA_TEXT = json.dumps(DebateTurn.model_json_schema(), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+

+        '本次 speaker 必须为 "bull"；角色语义不代表可以忽略反面证据。',

@@ -0,0 +1,116 @@
+"""REQ-QUAL-001 的确定性质量代理指标；不调用模型，也不修改输入。"""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from difflib import SequenceMatcher
+from unicodedata import category
+
+from .schemas import DebateTranscript, DebateTurn
+
+# 规范化后的相似度 >= 0.95 视为重复；固定阈值，禁用自动启发式过滤。
+CLAIM_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD = 0.95
+# 验收阈值：证据覆盖 == 1.0，反驳覆盖 >= 0.90，
+# 无证据断言率 <= 0.05，重复主张率 <= 0.10。
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class QualityMetrics:
+    """quality_available 仅表示可计算；是否达标需逐项比较验收阈值。"""
+
+    turns_with_evidence_or_no_new_evidence_rate: float | None = None
+    rebuttal_coverage: float | None = None
+    unsupported_claim_rate: float | None = None
+    duplicate_claim_rate: float | None = None
+    quality_available: bool = False
+
+
+def _normalize_claim(claim: str) -> str:
+    """统一大小写，将连续空白及 Unicode 标点合并为空格。"""
+    separated = "".join(
+        " " if char.isspace() or category(char).startswith("P") else char
+        for char in claim.casefold().strip()
+    )
+    return " ".join(separated.split())
+
+
+def _is_duplicate(claim: str, previous_claims: list[str]) -> bool:
+    return any(
+        claim == previous
+        or SequenceMatcher(None, previous, claim, autojunk=False).ratio()
+        >= CLAIM_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD
+        for previous in previous_claims
+    )
+
+
+def score_debate(
+    transcript: DebateTranscript | Mapping[str, object],
+) -> QualityMetrics:
+    """按原始发言顺序计分；不可用时四项数值均为 None。
+
+    不调用契约校验器：缺少证据和错误反驳引用本身就是需要计分的缺陷。
+    仅有开场发言时没有反驳义务，反驳覆盖率按 1.0 计算。
+    """
+    if isinstance(transcript, DebateTranscript):
+        turns = transcript.turns
+        available = transcript.quality_available
+    elif isinstance(transcript, Mapping):
+        turns = transcript.get("turns")
+        available = transcript.get("quality_available", False)
+    else:
+        return QualityMetrics()
+
+    if (
+        available is not True
+        or not isinstance(turns, Sequence)
+        or isinstance(turns, (str, bytes))
+        or not turns
+    ):
+        return QualityMetrics()
+
+    evidence_covered = rebuttals = unsupported = duplicates = 0
+    previous_ids: set[str] = set()
+    previous_claims: list[str] = []
+    for index, turn in enumerate(turns):
+        if isinstance(turn, DebateTurn):
+            turn = turn.model_dump(mode="python")
+        if not isinstance(turn, Mapping) or turn.get("status", "ok") != "ok":
+            return QualityMetrics()
+
+        turn_id = turn.get("turn_id")
+        claim = turn.get("claim")
+        refs = turn.get("evidence_refs")
+        no_new_evidence = turn.get("no_new_evidence", False)
+        if (
+            not isinstance(turn_id, str)
+            or not turn_id.strip()
+            or not isinstance(claim, str)
+            or not claim.strip()
+            or not isinstance(refs, list)
+            or not all(isinstance(ref, str) and ref.strip() for ref in refs)
+            or not isinstance(no_new_evidence, bool)
+        ):
+            return QualityMetrics()
+
+        evidence_covered += bool(refs) or no_new_evidence
+        # 无新增证据仍计入无证据断言；不能用 no_new_evidence 豁免此指标。
+        unsupported += not refs
+        target = turn.get("rebuttal_to")
+        if index > 0 and isinstance(target, str) and target in previous_ids:
+            rebuttals += 1
+        previous_ids.add(turn_id)
+
+        normalized = _normalize_claim(claim)
+        duplicates += _is_duplicate(normalized, previous_claims)
+        previous_claims.append(normalized)
+
+    total = len(turns)
+    return QualityMetrics(
+        turns_with_evidence_or_no_new_evidence_rate=evidence_covered / total,
+        rebuttal_coverage=rebuttals / (total - 1) if total > 1 else 1.0,
+        unsupported_claim_rate=unsupported / total,
+        duplicate_claim_rate=duplicates / total,
+        quality_available=True,
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["QualityMetrics", "score_debate"]

@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+"""复用唯一契约，校验发言字段与已有发言之间的关系。"""
+
+from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence
+from typing import Any
+
+from .schemas import DebateTranscript, DebateTurn
+
+
+def _turn_sequence(transcript: Any) -> Sequence:
+    if isinstance(transcript, DebateTranscript):
+        return transcript.turns
+    if isinstance(transcript, Mapping):
+        transcript = transcript.get("turns", ())
+    if isinstance(transcript, Sequence) and not isinstance(transcript, (str, bytes)):
+        return transcript
+    raise ValueError("transcript must contain a sequence of turns")
+
+
+def _parse_turn(turn: Any) -> DebateTurn:
+    # 重新校验模型实例，避免实例在创建后被外部修改而绕过契约。
+    if isinstance(turn, DebateTurn):
+        turn = turn.model_dump(mode="python")
+    return DebateTurn.model_validate(turn)
+
+
+def validate_turn(
+    turn: Any,
+    transcript: Any = (),
+    *,
+    expected_speaker: str | None = None,
+    expected_round: int | None = None,
+) -> DebateTurn:
+    """返回有效发言；引用只能指向传入历史中已经存在的 turn_id。"""
+    candidate = _parse_turn(turn)
+    previous = [_parse_turn(item) for item in _turn_sequence(transcript)]
+    ids = {item.turn_id for item in previous}
+    if len(ids) != len(previous) or candidate.turn_id in ids:
+        raise ValueError("turn_id must be unique within a transcript")
+    if any(
+        right.round <= left.round
+        for left, right in zip(previous, previous[1:], strict=False)
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("round must increase monotonically")
+    if previous:
+        if candidate.round <= previous[-1].round:
+            raise ValueError("round must increase monotonically")
+        if candidate.speaker == previous[-1].speaker:
+            raise ValueError("speakers must alternate")
+    if candidate.rebuttal_to is not None and candidate.rebuttal_to not in ids:
+        raise ValueError("rebuttal_to must reference an existing earlier turn_id")
+    if expected_speaker is not None and candidate.speaker != expected_speaker:
+        raise ValueError("speaker does not match the requested speaker")
+    if expected_round is not None and candidate.round != expected_round:
+        raise ValueError("round does not match the requested round")
+    return candidate
+
+
+def validate_turns(transcript: Any) -> list[DebateTurn]:
+    """按已有顺序校验历史，返回新列表，不修改输入。"""
+    validated: list[DebateTurn] = []
+    for item in _turn_sequence(transcript):
+        validated.append(validate_turn(item, validated))
+    return validated
+
+
+__all__ = ["validate_turn"]

+"""Part 6 cost, budget and price-table contracts.
+
+These models are the machine-readable boundary between the estimator,
+router, monitor and report layers.  Prices are CNY per million tokens,
+matching the official DeepSeek pricing page; cache pricing is intentionally
+modelled as cache-miss only for this release.
+"""
+
+from datetime import date
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, model_validator
+
+from .llm_event import RoutePath
+
+
+class TokenEstimate(BaseModel):
+    """Estimated input/output cost driver for one prospective model call."""
+
+    input_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    output_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    total_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    confidence: Literal["low", "medium", "high"]
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _total_must_match(self) -> "TokenEstimate":
+        if self.total_tokens != self.input_tokens + self.output_tokens:
+            raise ValueError("total_tokens must equal input_tokens + output_tokens")
+        return self
+
+
+class Budget(BaseModel):
+    """Per-profile token budget with inclusive soft/hard boundaries."""
+
+    profile: str
+    soft_limit: int = Field(gt=0)
+    hard_limit: int = Field(gt=0)
+    currency: Literal["CNY"] = "CNY"
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _soft_must_not_exceed_hard(self) -> "Budget":
+        if self.soft_limit > self.hard_limit:
+            raise ValueError("soft_limit must be <= hard_limit")
+        return self
+
+    def is_soft_exceeded(self, estimated_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return estimated_tokens >= self.soft_limit
+
+    def is_hard_exceeded(self, estimated_tokens: int) -> bool:
+        return estimated_tokens >= self.hard_limit
+
+
+class PricePair(BaseModel):
+    """Cache-miss input and output prices for one phase, per 1M tokens."""
+
+    input_cache_miss_per_1m: Decimal = Field(ge=0)
+    output_per_1m: Decimal = Field(ge=0)
+
+
+class ModelPrice(BaseModel):
+    """Published prices for one model in both peak and off-peak phases."""
+
+    model: str
+    model_version: str
+    peak: PricePair
+    off_peak: PricePair
+    cache_hit_input_per_1m: Decimal | None = None
+
+
+class PriceTable(BaseModel):
+    """Versioned, source-linked price table."""
+
+    currency: Literal["CNY"]
+    version: str
+    source_url: str
+    retrieved_at: date
+    models: dict[str, ModelPrice]
+
+
+class CostReport(BaseModel):
+    """Aggregated token/cost evidence for one run."""
+
+    run_id: str
+    profile: str
+
+    prompt_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    completion_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    total_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+
+    by_agent: dict[str, int]
+    by_model: dict[str, int]
+    by_tool: dict[str, int]
+
+    cost: Decimal
+    currency: Literal["CNY"] = "CNY"
+    price_table_version: str
+    price_table_source: str
+    peak_policy: str
+    cache_policy: str
+
+    coverage: float = Field(ge=0.0, le=1.0)
+    over_budget: bool
+    route_paths: list[RoutePath]
+    quality_floor_pass: bool

+"""Part 2 的唯一辩论字段定义；只包含数据契约及其一致性约束。"""
+
+from enum import StrEnum
+from typing import Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field, field_validator, model_validator
+
+
+class Stance(StrEnum):
+    """发言表达的立场，与发言者角色分开记录。"""
+
+    BULLISH = "bullish"
+    BEARISH = "bearish"
+    NEUTRAL = "neutral"
+
+
+class DebateTurn(BaseModel):
+    """一次结构化发言；引用的存在性由所属 Transcript 校验。"""
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+
+    turn_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    round: int = Field(ge=1, strict=True)
+    speaker: Literal["bull", "bear"]
+    claim: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    stance: Stance
+    evidence_refs: list[str]
+    assumptions: list[str]
+    rebuttal_to: str | None
+    confidence: float = Field(ge=0, le=1, strict=True, allow_inf_nan=False)
+    open_questions: list[str]
+    requested_evidence: list[str]
+    no_new_evidence: bool = Field(default=False, strict=True)
+    status: Literal["ok", "invalid"] = "ok"
+
+    @field_validator("turn_id", "claim", "rebuttal_to")
+    @classmethod
+    def _not_blank(cls, value: str | None) -> str | None:
+        if value is not None and not value.strip():
+            raise ValueError("text must not be blank")
+        return value
+
+    @field_validator("evidence_refs")
+    @classmethod
+    def _nonblank_refs(cls, refs: list[str]) -> list[str]:
+        if any(not ref.strip() for ref in refs):
+            raise ValueError("evidence_refs must contain nonblank strings")
+        return refs
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _requires_evidence_or_explicit_absence(self) -> "DebateTurn":
+        if not self.evidence_refs and not self.no_new_evidence:
+            raise ValueError("evidence_refs required unless no_new_evidence is true")
+        return self
+
+
+class DebateTranscript(BaseModel):
+    """同一辩论中的有序发言及质量指标可用性声明。"""
+
+    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")
+
+    transcript_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    turns: list[DebateTurn]
+    quality_available: bool = Field(strict=True)
+
+    @field_validator("transcript_id")
+    @classmethod
+    def _nonblank_id(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        if not value.strip():
+            raise ValueError("transcript_id must not be blank")
+        return value
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _consistent_turns(self) -> "DebateTranscript":
+        seen: set[str] = set()
+        for turn in self.turns:
+            if turn.turn_id in seen:
+                raise ValueError("turn_id must be unique within a transcript")
+            if turn.rebuttal_to is not None and turn.rebuttal_to not in seen:
+                raise ValueError("rebuttal_to must reference an existing earlier turn_id")
+            seen.add(turn.turn_id)
+        if self.quality_available and any(turn.status == "invalid" for turn in self.turns):
+            raise ValueError("invalid turns require quality_available to be false")
+        return self
+
+
+__all__ = ["DebateTranscript", "DebateTurn", "Stance"]

+"""Part 6 LLM call event contract.
+
+``LLMCallEvent`` is the single structured record emitted by the provider
+adapter for every model call.  Cost aggregation, manifest writing and audit
+all consume this object, so its fields and token arithmetic are validated at
+the boundary rather than re-checked in every report.
+"""
+
+from datetime import datetime
+from enum import StrEnum
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, model_validator
+
+
+class CallStatus(StrEnum):
+    """Terminal or retry state of one provider call."""
+
+    SUCCESS = "success"
+    RETRY = "retry"
+    FAILURE = "failure"
+
+
+class RoutePath(StrEnum):
+    """Budget route selected before a provider call."""
+
+    DIRECT = "direct"
+    SUMMARIZE = "summarize"
+    CHEAPER_MODEL = "cheaper_model"
+    HARD_FAIL = "hard_fail"
+
+
+class UsageSource(StrEnum):
+    """Where the token counts came from."""
+
+    PROVIDER = "provider"
+    ESTIMATED = "estimated"
+
+
+class LLMCallEvent(BaseModel):
+    """One LLM call, with enough context for cost and latency accounting."""
+
+    event_id: str
+    run_id: str
+    call_id: str
+    agent_name: str
+    model: str
+    provider: str
+
+    prompt_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    completion_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    total_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+
+    latency_ms: float = Field(ge=0)
+    status: CallStatus
+    retry_count: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
+    route_path: RoutePath
+    usage_source: UsageSource
+    timestamp: datetime
+
+    cache_hit: bool = False
+    tool_name: str | None = None
+
+    @field_validator("timestamp")
+    @classmethod
+    def _timestamp_must_be_timezone_aware(cls, value: datetime) -> datetime:
+        """Peak/off-peak pricing depends on a real instant, not a naive local time."""
+        if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+            raise ValueError("timestamp must be timezone-aware")
+        return value
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _token_sum_must_match(self) -> "LLMCallEvent":
+        if self.total_tokens != self.prompt_tokens + self.completion_tokens:
+            raise ValueError("total_tokens must equal prompt_tokens + completion_tokens")
+        return self

+"""Part 3 run manifest contract.
+
+``RunManifest`` is the single structured record written per run: what was
+analysed, with which models/profile/vendors, what it cost in tokens, what
+fallback/security events happened, the final rating, and the run status. It is the
+evidence artifact behind auditing, replay, cost attribution and latency/cost
+acceptance. The manifest stores metadata only — never raw vendor payloads.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import datetime
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, field_validator, model_validator
+
+_VALID_STATUS = ("completed", "failed", "review", "partial")
+
+
+class RunManifest(BaseModel):
+    """Structured, per-run metadata record."""
+
+    run_id: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    ticker: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    date: str = Field(min_length=1)
+    profile: str = "standard"
+    analysts: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    models: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    provider: str = ""
+    prompt_version: str = ""
+    config_hash: str = ""
+    vendor_versions: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    cache_hits: int = Field(default=0, ge=0)
+    token_usage_by_agent: dict[str, int] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    cost_estimate: float | None = None
+    fallback_events: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    security_events: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    rating: str | None = None
+    timestamps: dict[str, str] = Field(default_factory=dict)
+    status: str = "completed"
+
+    @field_validator("status")
+    @classmethod
+    def _status_known(cls, value: str) -> str:
+        if value not in _VALID_STATUS:
+            raise ValueError(f"unknown status: {value!r}")
+        return value
+
+    @field_validator("token_usage_by_agent")
+    @classmethod
+    def _non_negative_tokens(cls, value: dict[str, int]) -> dict[str, int]:
+        for agent, tokens in value.items():
+            if tokens < 0:
+                raise ValueError(f"token usage for {agent!r} is negative")
+        return value
+
+    def total_tokens(self) -> int:
+        """Sum of per-agent token usage."""
+        return sum(self.token_usage_by_agent.values())
+
+    @model_validator(mode="after")
+    def _timestamps_parse(self) -> RunManifest:
+        for key, value in self.timestamps.items():
+            try:
+                datetime.fromisoformat(value.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+            except (TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
+                raise ValueError(f"timestamp {key!r} is not ISO-8601: {value!r}") from exc
+        return self

@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+"""Per-agent context for cost attribution.
+
+The graph runs several agents through one callback.  A ContextVar carries the
+current agent name from the node into the callback, so ``by_agent`` stays
+correct without changing agent internals or duplicating LLM clients.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable, Iterator
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from contextvars import ContextVar
+from functools import wraps
+from typing import ParamSpec, TypeVar
+
+_current_agent: ContextVar[str | None] = ContextVar("current_agent", default=None)
+
+P = ParamSpec("P")
+R = TypeVar("R")
+
+
+def current_agent() -> str | None:
+    """The agent name set by the nearest ``agent_scope``, or None."""
+    return _current_agent.get()
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def agent_scope(name: str) -> Iterator[None]:
+    """Set the current agent for the duration of the block."""
+    token = _current_agent.set(name)
+    try:
+        yield
+    finally:
+        _current_agent.reset(token)
+
+
+def with_agent_scope(name: str, fn: Callable[P, R]) -> Callable[P, R]:
+    """Wrap a graph node so every LLM call inside it is attributed to ``name``."""
+
+    @wraps(fn)
+    def wrapped(*args: P.args, **kwargs: P.kwargs) -> R:
+        with agent_scope(name):
+            return fn(*args, **kwargs)
+
+    return wrapped

+++ tradingagents/tradingagents/cost/audit.py	
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+"""Token/cost audit over many runs for Part 6 acceptance."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from decimal import Decimal
+from typing import Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.cost import PriceTable
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import RoutePath
+from tradingagents.cost.monitor import nearest_rank
+from tradingagents.cost.report import compute_report_coverage
+
+
+class TokenRun(BaseModel):
+    """One run's token/cost evidence for the audit."""
+
+    run_id: str
+    profile: str
+    total_tokens: int = Field(ge=0)
+    has_report: bool
+    silent_over_budget: bool
+    cost: Decimal
+    cost_ground_truth: Decimal
+    quality_floor_pass: bool
+    route_paths: list[RoutePath]
+
+
+class TokenReport(BaseModel):
+    """Aggregated token/cost evidence for one profile."""
+
+    profile: str
+    p95_tokens: int
+    report_coverage: float
+    silent_over_budget_runs: int
+    cost_relative_error: float
+    routed_quality_floor_pass_rate: float
+    currency: Literal["CNY"]
+    price_table_version: str
+    price_table_source: str
+
+
+def _relative_error(cost: Decimal, truth: Decimal) -> float:
+    if truth == 0:
+        return 0.0 if cost == 0 else 1.0
+    return float(abs(cost - truth) / abs(truth))
+
+
+def build_token_report(
+    profile: str,
+    runs: list[TokenRun],
+    price_table: PriceTable,
+) -> TokenReport:
+    """Aggregate runs for ``profile`` into the acceptance report."""
+    selected = [run for run in runs if run.profile == profile]
+
+    token_values = [run.total_tokens for run in selected]
+    p95_tokens = int(nearest_rank(token_values, 0.95)) if token_values else 0
+
+    expected_ids = {run.run_id for run in selected}
+    reported_ids = {run.run_id for run in selected if run.has_report}
+    coverage = compute_report_coverage(expected_ids, reported_ids)
+
+    errors = [
+        _relative_error(run.cost, run.cost_ground_truth)
+        for run in selected
+    ]
+    # Worst run wins: one 6% error must not hide behind many perfect runs.
+    cost_error = max(errors) if errors else 0.0
+
+    routed = [
+        run
+        for run in selected
+        if any(path is not RoutePath.DIRECT for path in run.route_paths)
+    ]
+    if routed:
+        routed_quality = sum(1 for run in routed if run.quality_floor_pass) / len(routed)
+    else:
+        routed_quality = 1.0
+
+    return TokenReport(
+        profile=profile,
+        p95_tokens=p95_tokens,
+        report_coverage=coverage,
+        silent_over_budget_runs=sum(1 for run in selected if run.silent_over_budget),
+        cost_relative_error=cost_error,
+        routed_quality_floor_pass_rate=routed_quality,
+        currency=price_table.currency,
+        price_table_version=price_table.version,
+        price_table_source=price_table.source_url,
+    )
+
+
+def assert_token_acceptance(report: TokenReport, *, hard_limit: int) -> None:
+    """Apply the token/cost acceptance gates."""
+    if report.p95_tokens > hard_limit:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"p95 tokens {report.p95_tokens} exceed hard limit {hard_limit}"
+        )
+    if report.report_coverage != 1.0:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"report coverage {report.report_coverage:.3f} is not 1.0"
+        )
+    if report.silent_over_budget_runs != 0:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"silent over-budget runs: {report.silent_over_budget_runs}"
+        )
+    if report.cost_relative_error > 0.05:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"cost relative error {report.cost_relative_error:.3f} exceeds 0.05"
+        )
+    if report.routed_quality_floor_pass_rate != 1.0:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            "routed runs failed the quality floor: "
+            f"{report.routed_quality_floor_pass_rate:.3f}"
+        )
+    if report.currency != "CNY":
+        raise AssertionError(f"expected CNY, got {report.currency!r}")
+    if not report.price_table_version or not report.price_table_source:
+        raise AssertionError("price table provenance is incomplete")

@@ -0,0 +1,212 @@
+"""Latency report aggregation and acceptance gates for Part 6.
+
+Real 15+15 / 3+3 runs happen in the manual benchmark script; this module only
+turns measured samples into a report and applies the agreed gates.  That keeps
+the gates testable without network access.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Literal
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+from tradingagents.cost.monitor import nearest_rank
+
+
+class LatencySample(BaseModel):
+    """One measured end-to-end latency sample."""
+
+    profile: str
+    cache_state: Literal["cold", "warm"]
+    duration_s: float = Field(ge=0)
+    success: bool = True
+
+
+class LatencyReport(BaseModel):
+    """Aggregated latency evidence for one profile."""
+
+    profile: str
+    cold_runs: int
+    warm_runs: int
+    successful_runs: int
+    failed_runs: int
+    p50_s: float
+    p95_s: float
+    p99_s: float
+    failure_rate: float
+    baseline_p95_s: float | None = None
+    improvement: float | None = None
+
+
+class LatencyPolicy(BaseModel):
+    """Profile-specific acceptance policy."""
+
+    require_improvement: bool
+    min_improvement: float | None = None
+    absolute_p95_target_s: float | None = None
+
+
+LATENCY_POLICIES: dict[str, LatencyPolicy] = {
+    "quick": LatencyPolicy(
+        require_improvement=True,
+        min_improvement=0.30,
+        absolute_p95_target_s=300,
+    ),
+    "standard": LatencyPolicy(
+        require_improvement=True,
+        min_improvement=0.30,
+        absolute_p95_target_s=720,
+    ),
+    "deep": LatencyPolicy(
+        require_improvement=False,
+        absolute_p95_target_s=1800,
+    ),
+}
+
+
+def policy_for_profile(profile: str) -> LatencyPolicy:
+    """Return the agreed policy, failing loudly for an unknown profile."""
+    try:
+        return LATENCY_POLICIES[profile]
+    except KeyError as exc:
+        raise ValueError(f"unknown latency profile {profile!r}") from exc
+
+
+def summarize_latency(
+    profile: str,
+    samples: list[LatencySample],
+    *,
+    baseline_p95_s: float | None = None,
+) -> LatencyReport:
+    """Summarise samples for ``profile`` using nearest-rank percentiles.
+
+    Failed runs count toward ``failure_rate`` but are excluded from latency
+    percentiles, so a timeout cannot masquerade as a very fast run.
+    """
+    selected = [sample for sample in samples if sample.profile == profile]
+    if not selected:
+        raise ValueError(f"no latency samples for profile {profile!r}")
+
+    successes = [sample for sample in selected if sample.success]
+    durations = [sample.duration_s for sample in successes]
+
+    p50 = nearest_rank(durations, 0.50) if durations else 0.0
+    p95 = nearest_rank(durations, 0.95) if durations else 0.0
+    p99 = nearest_rank(durations, 0.99) if durations else 0.0
+    failure_rate = 1.0 - (len(successes) / len(selected))
+
+    improvement = None
+    if baseline_p95_s is not None and baseline_p95_s > 0:
+        improvement = (baseline_p95_s - p95) / baseline_p95_s
+
+    return LatencyReport(
+        profile=profile,
+        cold_runs=sum(1 for sample in selected if sample.cache_state == "cold"),
+        warm_runs=sum(1 for sample in selected if sample.cache_state == "warm"),
+        successful_runs=len(successes),
+        failed_runs=len(selected) - len(successes),
+        p50_s=p50,
+        p95_s=p95,
+        p99_s=p99,
+        failure_rate=failure_rate,
+        baseline_p95_s=baseline_p95_s,
+        improvement=improvement,
+    )
+
+
+def _resolve_policy(
+    report: LatencyReport,
+    *,
+    policy: LatencyPolicy | None,
+    require_improvement: bool | None,
+    min_improvement: float | None,
+    absolute_p95_target_s: float | None,
+) -> LatencyPolicy:
+    base = policy
+    if base is None:
+        base = LATENCY_POLICIES.get(report.profile)
+    if base is None:
+        if (
+            require_improvement is None
+            and min_improvement is None
+            and absolute_p95_target_s is None
+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"no latency policy for profile {report.profile!r}; "
+                "pass a policy or explicit overrides"
+            )
+        base = LatencyPolicy(require_improvement=True, min_improvement=0.30)
+
+    updates: dict[str, object] = {}
+    if require_improvement is not None:
+        updates["require_improvement"] = require_improvement
+    if min_improvement is not None:
+        updates["min_improvement"] = min_improvement
+    if absolute_p95_target_s is not None:
+        updates["absolute_p95_target_s"] = absolute_p95_target_s
+    return base.model_copy(update=updates) if updates else base
+
+
+def latency_warnings(
+    report: LatencyReport,
+    *,
+    policy: LatencyPolicy | None = None,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Non-blocking absolute-p95 warnings for a report's profile."""
+    resolved = policy or policy_for_profile(report.profile)
+    warnings: list[str] = []
+    if (
+        resolved.absolute_p95_target_s is not None
+        and report.p95_s > resolved.absolute_p95_target_s
+    ):
+        warnings.append(
+            f"absolute p95 {report.p95_s:.1f}s exceeds "
+            f"{resolved.absolute_p95_target_s:.1f}s (record-only)"
+        )
+    return warnings
+
+
+def assert_latency_acceptance(
+    report: LatencyReport,
+    *,
+    policy: LatencyPolicy | None = None,
+    require_improvement: bool | None = None,
+    min_improvement: float | None = None,
+    absolute_p95_target_s: float | None = None,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Apply the agreed latency gates and return non-blocking warnings.
+
+    Failure rate always gates.  Relative improvement gates when the resolved
+    policy requires it.  Absolute p95 is record-only and produces a warning,
+    never an exception.
+    """
+    resolved = _resolve_policy(
+        report,
+        policy=policy,
+        require_improvement=require_improvement,
+        min_improvement=min_improvement,
+        absolute_p95_target_s=absolute_p95_target_s,
+    )
+
+    if report.failure_rate > 0.01:
+        raise AssertionError(
+            f"benchmark failure rate {report.failure_rate:.3f} exceeds 0.01"
+        )
+
+    if resolved.require_improvement:
+        required = (
+            resolved.min_improvement
+            if resolved.min_improvement is not None
+            else 0.30
+        )
+        if report.improvement is None:
+            raise AssertionError(
+                "baseline p95 is required when improvement is required"
+            )
+        if report.improvement < required:
+            raise AssertionError(
+                f"p95 improvement {report.improvement:.3f} is below {required:.3f}"
+            )
+
+    return latency_warnings(report, policy=resolved)

+"""Per-profile token budgets for Part 6 routing.
+
+Hard limits come from the acceptance targets in the requirements document.
+Soft limits are the target (not the cap), so crossing the target triggers
+summarisation before the run reaches the hard stop.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.cost import Budget
+
+_PROFILE_LIMITS: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {
+    # profile: (soft target, hard acceptance cap)
+    "quick": (20_000, 25_000),
+    "standard": (50_000, 60_000),
+    "deep": (120_000, 150_000),
+}
+
+
+def budget_for_profile(
+    profile: str,
+    *,
+    profile_config: Any | None = None,
+) -> Budget:
+    """Build the budget for ``profile``.
+
+    ``profile_config`` (Part 1) is the source of truth when it carries
+    ``soft_token_limit`` / ``hard_token_limit``.  Otherwise the documented
+    presets apply, so Part 6 can run with a stub while Part 1 is in progress.
+    """
+    if profile_config is not None:
+        name = getattr(profile_config, "name", None) or profile
+        preset = _PROFILE_LIMITS.get(profile) or _PROFILE_LIMITS.get(name)
+        soft = getattr(profile_config, "soft_token_limit", None)
+        hard = getattr(profile_config, "hard_token_limit", None)
+        if soft is None and preset is not None:
+            soft = preset[0]
+        if hard is None and preset is not None:
+            hard = preset[1]
+        if soft is not None and hard is not None:
+            return Budget(
+                profile=name,
+                soft_limit=int(soft),
+                hard_limit=int(hard),
+                currency="CNY",
+            )
+
+    if profile not in _PROFILE_LIMITS:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"Unknown run profile {profile!r}; expected one of "
+            f"{', '.join(sorted(_PROFILE_LIMITS))}"
+        )
+
+    soft, hard = _PROFILE_LIMITS[profile]
+    return Budget(profile=profile, soft_limit=soft, hard_limit=hard, currency="CNY")

@@ -0,0 +1,252 @@
+"""LangChain callback that turns real provider calls into LLMCallEvent records.
+
+The callback is deliberately independent of Part 1-5: it can be passed to the
+existing ``TradingAgentsGraph(callbacks=[...])`` and records whatever the base
+provider adapter reports.  Missing provider usage falls back to the local
+estimator and is marked ``estimated`` rather than silently dropped.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import threading
+import time
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime
+from typing import Any
+
+from langchain_core.callbacks import BaseCallbackHandler
+from langchain_core.messages import BaseMessage
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import (
+    CallStatus,
+    LLMCallEvent,
+    RoutePath,
+    UsageSource,
+)
+from tradingagents.cost.agent_context import current_agent
+from tradingagents.cost.estimator import estimate_tokens
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _CallState:
+    started: float
+    prompt_text: str
+    model: str
+    agent_name: str
+
+
+def _serialized_model(serialized: dict[str, Any], fallback: str) -> str:
+    kwargs = serialized.get("kwargs") or {}
+    return (
+        kwargs.get("model_name")
+        or kwargs.get("model")
+        or serialized.get("model_name")
+        or fallback
+    )
+
+
+def _usage_from_mapping(usage: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+    prompt = usage.get("prompt_tokens", usage.get("input_tokens"))
+    completion = usage.get("completion_tokens", usage.get("output_tokens"))
+    total = usage.get("total_tokens")
+    if prompt is None and completion is None and total is None:
+        return None
+    prompt = int(prompt or 0)
+    completion = int(completion or 0)
+    total = int(total if total is not None else prompt + completion)
+    return prompt, completion, total
+
+
+def _extract_usage(response: Any) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+    llm_output = getattr(response, "llm_output", None) or {}
+    if isinstance(llm_output, dict):
+        for key in ("token_usage", "usage"):
+            usage = llm_output.get(key)
+            if isinstance(usage, dict):
+                parsed = _usage_from_mapping(usage)
+                if parsed is not None:
+                    return parsed
+
+    for batch in getattr(response, "generations", []) or []:
+        for generation in batch:
+            message = getattr(generation, "message", None)
+            if message is not None:
+                metadata = getattr(message, "usage_metadata", None) or {}
+                if isinstance(metadata, dict):
+                    parsed = _usage_from_mapping(metadata)
+                    if parsed is not None:
+                        return parsed
+                response_metadata = getattr(message, "response_metadata", None) or {}
+                if isinstance(response_metadata, dict):
+                    parsed = _usage_from_mapping(
+                        response_metadata.get("token_usage") or {}
+                    )
+                    if parsed is not None:
+                        return parsed
+    return None
+
+
+def _message_text(content: Any) -> str:
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        return content
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        parts = []
+        for item in content:
+            if isinstance(item, str):
+                parts.append(item)
+            elif isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("type") == "text":
+                parts.append(str(item.get("text") or ""))
+        return "\n".join(part for part in parts if part)
+    return str(content or "")
+
+
+def _extract_text(response: Any) -> str:
+    for batch in getattr(response, "generations", []) or []:
+        for generation in batch:
+            text = getattr(generation, "text", None)
+            if text:
+                return str(text)
+            message = getattr(generation, "message", None)
+            if message is not None:
+                return _message_text(getattr(message, "content", ""))
+    return ""
+
+
+class CostTrackingCallback(BaseCallbackHandler):
+    """Emit one ``LLMCallEvent`` per completed or failed model call."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        run_id: str,
+        on_event: Callable[[LLMCallEvent], None],
+        agent_name: str = "unknown",
+        provider: str = "unknown",
+        route_path: RoutePath = RoutePath.DIRECT,
+        cache_hit: bool = False,
+        default_model: str = "unknown",
+    ):
+        self.run_id = run_id
+        self.on_event = on_event
+        self.agent_name = agent_name
+        self.provider = provider
+        self.route_path = route_path
+        self.cache_hit = cache_hit
+        self.default_model = default_model
+        self._states: dict[str, _CallState] = {}
+        self._lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def _start(
+        self,
+        run_id: Any,
+        prompt_text: str,
+        serialized: dict[str, Any],
+    ) -> None:
+        state = _CallState(
+            started=time.perf_counter(),
+            prompt_text=prompt_text,
+            model=_serialized_model(serialized, self.default_model),
+            agent_name=current_agent() or self.agent_name,
+        )
+        with self._lock:
+            self._states[str(run_id)] = state
+
+    def _take(self, run_id: Any) -> _CallState:
+        with self._lock:
+            return self._states.pop(
+                str(run_id),
+                _CallState(
+                    started=time.perf_counter(),
+                    prompt_text="",
+                    model=self.default_model,
+                    agent_name=self.agent_name,
+                ),
+            )
+
+    def on_chat_model_start(
+        self,
+        serialized: dict[str, Any],
+        messages: list[list[BaseMessage]],
+        *,
+        run_id: Any,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        text = "\n".join(
+            _message_text(getattr(message, "content", message))
+            for batch in messages
+            for message in batch
+        )
+        self._start(run_id, text, serialized)
+
+    def on_llm_start(
+        self,
+        serialized: dict[str, Any],
+        prompts: list[str],
+        *,
+        run_id: Any,
+        **kwargs: Any,
+    ) -> None:
+        self._start(run_id, "\n".join(prompts), serialized)
+
+    def on_llm_end(self, response: Any, *, run_id: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        state = self._take(run_id)
+        latency_ms = max(0.0, (time.perf_counter() - state.started) * 1000.0)
+        usage = _extract_usage(response)
+
+        if usage is None:
+            prompt_tokens = estimate_tokens(state.prompt_text, state.model).input_tokens
+            completion_tokens = estimate_tokens(
+                _extract_text(response),
+                state.model,
+            ).input_tokens
+            total_tokens = prompt_tokens + completion_tokens
+            source = UsageSource.ESTIMATED
+        else:
+            prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens = usage
+            source = UsageSource.PROVIDER
+
+        self.on_event(
+            LLMCallEvent(
+                event_id=str(run_id),
+                run_id=self.run_id,
+                call_id=str(run_id),
+                agent_name=state.agent_name,
+                model=state.model,
+                provider=self.provider,
+                prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
+                completion_tokens=completion_tokens,
+                total_tokens=total_tokens,
+                latency_ms=latency_ms,
+                status=CallStatus.SUCCESS,
+                retry_count=0,
+                route_path=self.route_path,
+                usage_source=source,
+                timestamp=datetime.now(UTC),
+                cache_hit=self.cache_hit,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def on_llm_error(self, error: BaseException, *, run_id: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> None:
+        state = self._take(run_id)
+        latency_ms = max(0.0, (time.perf_counter() - state.started) * 1000.0)
+        self.on_event(
+            LLMCallEvent(
+                event_id=str(run_id),
+                run_id=self.run_id,
+                call_id=str(run_id),
+                agent_name=state.agent_name,
+                model=state.model,
+                provider=self.provider,
+                prompt_tokens=0,
+                completion_tokens=0,
+                total_tokens=0,
+                latency_ms=latency_ms,
+                status=CallStatus.FAILURE,
+                retry_count=0,
+                route_path=self.route_path,
+                usage_source=UsageSource.ESTIMATED,
+                timestamp=datetime.now(UTC),
+                cache_hit=self.cache_hit,
+            )
+        )

+"""Offline CLI entry points for Part 6 benchmark and token audit.
+
+The scripts under ``scripts/`` are thin wrappers around these functions.  The
+offline mode reads JSONL fixtures, so it works before Part 1-5 are available.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+from tradingagents.cost.audit import (
+    TokenRun,
+    assert_token_acceptance,
+    build_token_report,
+)
+from tradingagents.cost.benchmark import (
+    LatencySample,
+    assert_latency_acceptance,
+    latency_warnings,
+    summarize_latency,
+)
+from tradingagents.cost.budget import budget_for_profile
+from tradingagents.cost.pricing import default_price_table
+
+
+def _load_jsonl(path: str | Path, model: type[BaseModel]) -> list[Any]:
+    text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    return [
+        model.model_validate_json(line)
+        for line in text.splitlines()
+        if line.strip()
+    ]
+
+
+def _emit(payload: dict[str, Any], out: str | Path | None) -> None:
+    text = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+    if out is None:
+        print(text)
+    else:
+        Path(out).write_text(text + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def bench_latency_main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Summarise latency samples and optionally apply acceptance gates."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="bench_latency.py",
+        description="Summarise latency samples from JSONL (offline mode).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True, choices=["quick", "standard", "deep"])
+    parser.add_argument("--samples-jsonl", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--baseline-p95-s", type=float, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--out", default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--assert", dest="assert_gate", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    samples: list[LatencySample] = _load_jsonl(args.samples_jsonl, LatencySample)
+    report = summarize_latency(
+        args.profile,
+        samples,
+        baseline_p95_s=args.baseline_p95_s,
+    )
+
+    payload = report.model_dump(mode="json")
+    payload["gate_passed"] = None
+    payload["warnings"] = latency_warnings(report)
+
+    code = 0
+    if args.assert_gate:
+        try:
+            payload["warnings"] = assert_latency_acceptance(report)
+            payload["gate_passed"] = True
+        except AssertionError as exc:
+            payload["gate_passed"] = False
+            payload["gate_error"] = str(exc)
+            print(f"latency gate failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+            code = 1
+
+    _emit(payload, args.out)
+    return code
+
+
+def token_audit_main(argv: Sequence[str] | None = None) -> int:
+    """Summarise token runs and optionally apply acceptance gates."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
+        prog="token_audit.py",
+        description="Audit token/cost runs from JSONL (offline mode).",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--profile", required=True, choices=["quick", "standard", "deep"])
+    parser.add_argument(
+        "--runs-jsonl",
+        "--events-jsonl",
+        dest="runs_jsonl",
+        required=True,
+        help="TokenRun JSONL; --events-jsonl is accepted as an alias.",
+    )
+    parser.add_argument("--hard-limit", type=int, default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--out", default=None)
+    parser.add_argument("--assert", dest="assert_gate", action="store_true")
+    args = parser.parse_args(argv)
+
+    runs: list[TokenRun] = _load_jsonl(args.runs_jsonl, TokenRun)
+    table = default_price_table()
+    report = build_token_report(args.profile, runs, table)
+    hard_limit = (
+        args.hard_limit
+        if args.hard_limit is not None
+        else budget_for_profile(args.profile).hard_limit
+    )
+
+    payload = report.model_dump(mode="json")
+    payload["hard_limit"] = hard_limit
+    payload["gate_passed"] = None
+
+    code = 0
+    if args.assert_gate:
+        try:
+            assert_token_acceptance(report, hard_limit=hard_limit)
+            payload["gate_passed"] = True
+        except AssertionError as exc:
+            payload["gate_passed"] = False
+            payload["gate_error"] = str(exc)
+            print(f"token audit gate failed: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
+            code = 1
+
+    _emit(payload, args.out)
+    return code
+
+
+__all__ = ["bench_latency_main", "token_audit_main"]

+"""Hard-fail guarantees and quality-floor rollback for Part 6."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+from typing import Literal, TypeVar
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.cost import Budget, CostReport
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import RoutePath
+from tradingagents.cost.monitor import CostMonitor
+from tradingagents.cost.router import RouteDecision, route
+
+T = TypeVar("T")
+
+_EXIT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED = 2
+
+
+class BudgetExceededError(RuntimeError):
+    """Raised before a provider call when the hard budget would be exceeded."""
+
+
+class BudgetExceededResult(BaseModel):
+    """The auditable record produced by a hard budget stop."""
+
+    status: Literal["budget_exceeded"]
+    final_rating: Literal["REVIEW"]
+    exit_code: int
+    estimated_tokens: int
+    budget: Budget
+    cost_report: CostReport
+
+
+def guarded_call(
+    estimated_tokens: int,
+    budget: Budget,
+    call: Callable[[], T],
+) -> T:
+    """Run ``call`` only when the route is not ``hard_fail``."""
+    decision = route(estimated_tokens, budget)
+    if decision.route_path is RoutePath.HARD_FAIL:
+        raise BudgetExceededError(
+            f"budget hard limit exceeded: estimated={estimated_tokens}, "
+            f"hard={budget.hard_limit}"
+        )
+    return call()
+
+
+def handle_budget_exceeded(
+    run_id: str,
+    estimated_tokens: int,
+    budget: Budget,
+    monitor: CostMonitor,
+) -> BudgetExceededResult:
+    """Build the hard-fail record without calling the provider."""
+    if not budget.is_hard_exceeded(estimated_tokens):
+        raise ValueError("handle_budget_exceeded called without a hard-limit breach")
+
+    report = monitor.report(
+        run_id,
+        budget,
+        quality_floor_pass=False,
+        over_budget=True,
+    )
+    return BudgetExceededResult(
+        status="budget_exceeded",
+        final_rating="REVIEW",
+        exit_code=_EXIT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED,
+        estimated_tokens=estimated_tokens,
+        budget=budget,
+        cost_report=report,
+    )
+
+
+def apply_quality_floor(
+    decision: RouteDecision,
+    *,
+    quality_floor_pass: bool,
+) -> RouteDecision:
+    """Revert a cost-saving route when the routed run failed its quality floor."""
+    if quality_floor_pass or decision.route_path is RoutePath.DIRECT:
+        return decision
+
+    return RouteDecision(
+        route_path=RoutePath.DIRECT,
+        estimated_tokens=decision.estimated_tokens,
+        reason="quality floor failed; cost route reverted to direct",
+    )

@@ -0,0 +1,74 @@
+"""Deterministic, network-free token estimation for budget routing.
+
+The estimator is deliberately a conservative approximation, not a provider
+tokenizer: it is used to choose a route before a call, while final cost comes
+from provider-reported usage.  CJK characters count as one token each; runs
+of ASCII word characters count as one token; punctuation is counted
+separately.  This keeps estimates stable across providers and test runs.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.cost import TokenEstimate
+
+_KNOWN_MODELS = frozenset({"deepseek-flash", "deepseek-v4-pro"})
+
+_CJK = re.compile(r"[\u3400-\u4dbf\u4e00-\u9fff\uf900-\ufaff]")
+_ASCII_WORD = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+")
+_OTHER_SYMBOL = re.compile(r"[^\w\s]", re.UNICODE)
+
+_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_CAP = 4096
+
+
+def _as_text(messages: str | Sequence[str]) -> str:
+    if isinstance(messages, str):
+        return messages
+    return "\n".join(str(message) for message in messages)
+
+
+def _count_tokens(text: str) -> int:
+    if not text.strip():
+        return 0
+    cjk = len(_CJK.findall(text))
+    without_cjk = _CJK.sub(" ", text)
+    words = len(_ASCII_WORD.findall(without_cjk))
+    symbols = len(_OTHER_SYMBOL.findall(without_cjk))
+    return cjk + words + symbols
+
+
+def estimate_tokens(
+    messages: str | Sequence[str],
+    model: str,
+    *,
+    max_output_tokens: int | None = None,
+) -> TokenEstimate:
+    """Estimate input/output tokens for a prospective call.
+
+    ``max_output_tokens`` is a hard cap when supplied.  Empty input returns a
+    zero estimate rather than a synthetic minimum, so callers can distinguish
+    "nothing to send" from a real prompt.
+    """
+    text = _as_text(messages)
+    input_tokens = _count_tokens(text)
+
+    if input_tokens == 0:
+        return TokenEstimate(
+            input_tokens=0,
+            output_tokens=0,
+            total_tokens=0,
+            confidence="low",
+        )
+
+    output_tokens = max(1, min(_DEFAULT_OUTPUT_CAP, input_tokens // 4))
+    if max_output_tokens is not None:
+        output_tokens = min(output_tokens, max(0, max_output_tokens))
+
+    return TokenEstimate(
+        input_tokens=input_tokens,
+        output_tokens=output_tokens,
+        total_tokens=input_tokens + output_tokens,
+        confidence="medium" if model in _KNOWN_MODELS else "low",
+    )

@@ -0,0 +1,131 @@
+"""Cost aggregation for Part 6.
+
+The monitor turns ``LLMCallEvent`` records into a ``CostReport``.  It is the
+only place that applies the CNY price table, peak/off-peak phase and
+cache-miss policy; callers never recompute cost themselves.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from datetime import datetime, time
+from decimal import Decimal
+from math import ceil
+from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.cost import Budget, CostReport, PriceTable
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import LLMCallEvent, RoutePath
+
+_SHANGHAI = ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")
+_MILLION = Decimal(1_000_000)
+_PEAK_POLICY = "weekday_hours_ignore_holidays"
+_CACHE_POLICY = "cache_miss"
+
+
+def price_phase(timestamp: datetime) -> str:
+    """Return ``peak`` or ``off_peak`` using Beijing weekday hours.
+
+    Holidays are intentionally ignored, per the agreed policy: a weekday
+    holiday inside 09:00-12:00 or 14:00-18:00 is still priced as peak.
+    """
+    if timestamp.tzinfo is None or timestamp.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError("timestamp must be timezone-aware")
+
+    local = timestamp.astimezone(_SHANGHAI)
+    if local.weekday() >= 5:
+        return "off_peak"
+
+    current = local.time()
+    morning = time(9, 0) <= current < time(12, 0)
+    afternoon = time(14, 0) <= current < time(18, 0)
+    return "peak" if morning or afternoon else "off_peak"
+
+
+def nearest_rank(values: Sequence[float], percentile: float) -> float:
+    """Nearest-rank percentile (p50=50, p95=95 for 1..100)."""
+    if not values:
+        raise ValueError("nearest_rank requires at least one value")
+    if not 0.0 <= percentile <= 1.0:
+        raise ValueError("percentile must be in [0, 1]")
+
+    ordered = sorted(values)
+    index = max(0, min(len(ordered) - 1, ceil(percentile * len(ordered)) - 1))
+    return ordered[index]
+
+
+class CostMonitor:
+    """Collects call events for one run and emits a cost report."""
+
+    def __init__(self, price_table: PriceTable):
+        self.price_table = price_table
+        self._events: list[LLMCallEvent] = []
+
+    def record(self, event: LLMCallEvent) -> None:
+        self._events.append(event)
+
+    @property
+    def events(self) -> tuple[LLMCallEvent, ...]:
+        return tuple(self._events)
+
+    def report(
+        self,
+        run_id: str,
+        budget: Budget,
+        *,
+        quality_floor_pass: bool,
+        over_budget: bool | None = None,
+    ) -> CostReport:
+        events = tuple(event for event in self._events if event.run_id == run_id)
+        prompt_tokens = sum(event.prompt_tokens for event in events)
+        completion_tokens = sum(event.completion_tokens for event in events)
+        total_tokens = sum(event.total_tokens for event in events)
+
+        by_agent: dict[str, int] = {}
+        by_model: dict[str, int] = {}
+        by_tool: dict[str, int] = {}
+        route_paths: list[RoutePath] = []
+        cost = Decimal(0)
+
+        for event in events:
+            by_agent[event.agent_name] = by_agent.get(event.agent_name, 0) + event.total_tokens
+            by_model[event.model] = by_model.get(event.model, 0) + event.total_tokens
+            tool = event.tool_name or "unknown"
+            by_tool[tool] = by_tool.get(tool, 0) + event.total_tokens
+            if event.route_path not in route_paths:
+                route_paths.append(event.route_path)
+
+            model_price = self.price_table.models.get(event.model)
+            if model_price is None:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"model {event.model!r} is missing from price table "
+                    f"{self.price_table.version!r}"
+                )
+            phase = price_phase(event.timestamp)
+            pair = model_price.peak if phase == "peak" else model_price.off_peak
+            cost += (
+                Decimal(event.prompt_tokens) * pair.input_cache_miss_per_1m
+                + Decimal(event.completion_tokens) * pair.output_per_1m
+            ) / _MILLION
+
+        return CostReport(
+            run_id=run_id,
+            profile=budget.profile,
+            prompt_tokens=prompt_tokens,
+            completion_tokens=completion_tokens,
+            total_tokens=total_tokens,
+            by_agent=by_agent,
+            by_model=by_model,
+            by_tool=by_tool,
+            cost=cost,
+            currency=self.price_table.currency,
+            price_table_version=self.price_table.version,
+            price_table_source=self.price_table.source_url,
+            peak_policy=_PEAK_POLICY,
+            cache_policy=_CACHE_POLICY,
+            coverage=1.0,
+            over_budget=(
+                budget.is_hard_exceeded(total_tokens) if over_budget is None else over_budget
+            ),
+            route_paths=route_paths,
+            quality_floor_pass=quality_floor_pass,
+        )

+"""Budget routing and context summarisation for Part 6.
+
+Routing is intentionally a pure decision: it does not call providers and does
+not mutate run state.  That keeps the hard-fail guarantee testable without
+network access.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Iterable, Mapping
+from typing import Any
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel
+
+from tradingagents.contracts.cost import Budget, PriceTable
+from tradingagents.contracts.llm_event import RoutePath
+
+_SUMMARY_STRING_LIMIT = 500
+_SUMMARY_LIST_LIMIT = 20
+
+
+class RouteDecision(BaseModel):
+    """The route chosen for one prospective model call."""
+
+    route_path: RoutePath
+    estimated_tokens: int
+    reason: str
+
+
+def route(estimated_tokens: int, budget: Budget) -> RouteDecision:
+    """Choose direct, summarise, or hard-fail before a provider call."""
+    if estimated_tokens < 0:
+        raise ValueError("estimated_tokens must be >= 0")
+
+    if budget.is_hard_exceeded(estimated_tokens):
+        return RouteDecision(
+            route_path=RoutePath.HARD_FAIL,
+            estimated_tokens=estimated_tokens,
+            reason="hard budget limit exceeded; provider call blocked",
+        )
+    if budget.is_soft_exceeded(estimated_tokens):
+        return RouteDecision(
+            route_path=RoutePath.SUMMARIZE,
+            estimated_tokens=estimated_tokens,
+            reason="soft budget limit exceeded; summarise before calling",
+        )
+    return RouteDecision(
+        route_path=RoutePath.DIRECT,
+        estimated_tokens=estimated_tokens,
+        reason="within soft budget; call directly",
+    )
+
+
+def route_after_summary(summary_tokens: int, budget: Budget) -> RouteDecision:
+    """Choose the next route after a summary has been produced."""
+    if summary_tokens < 0:
+        raise ValueError("summary_tokens must be >= 0")
+
+    if budget.is_hard_exceeded(summary_tokens):
+        return RouteDecision(
+            route_path=RoutePath.HARD_FAIL,
+            estimated_tokens=summary_tokens,
+            reason="hard budget limit exceeded after summarisation",
+        )
+    if budget.is_soft_exceeded(summary_tokens):
+        return RouteDecision(
+            route_path=RoutePath.CHEAPER_MODEL,
+            estimated_tokens=summary_tokens,
+            reason="still above soft limit after summarisation; use a cheaper model",
+        )
+    return RouteDecision(
+        route_path=RoutePath.DIRECT,
+        estimated_tokens=summary_tokens,
+        reason="summary brought the call within the soft budget",
+    )
+
+
+def _summarize_value(value: Any, *, protected: bool) -> Any:
+    if protected:
+        return value
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        if len(value) <= _SUMMARY_STRING_LIMIT:
+            return value
+        return value[:_SUMMARY_STRING_LIMIT] + "…"
+    if isinstance(value, Mapping):
+        return {
+            key: _summarize_value(item, protected=False)
+            for key, item in value.items()
+        }
+    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+        trimmed = list(value[:_SUMMARY_LIST_LIMIT])
+        return [
+            _summarize_value(item, protected=False)
+            for item in trimmed
+        ]
+    return value
+
+
+def summarize_context(
+    context: Mapping[str, Any],
+    *,
+    protected_keys: Iterable[str] = (),
+) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    """Return a shortened copy while preserving decision-critical keys."""
+    protected = frozenset(protected_keys)
+    return {
+        key: _summarize_value(value, protected=key in protected)
+        for key, value in context.items()
+    }
+
+
+def select_cheaper_model(
+    model: str,
+    *,
+    price_table: PriceTable,
+    allowed_models: Iterable[str] | None = None,
+) -> str:
+    """Pick the least expensive allowed model by off-peak input+output price."""
+    if model not in price_table.models:
+        raise ValueError(f"model {model!r} is not present in the price table")
+
+    if allowed_models is None:
+        candidates = set(price_table.models)
+    else:
+        candidates = set(allowed_models) & set(price_table.models)
+
+    if not candidates:
+        raise ValueError("no allowed models are present in the price table")
+
+    def score(candidate: str) -> tuple[Any, str]:
+        price = price_table.models[candidate].off_peak
+        return (price.input_cache_miss_per_1m + price.output_per_1m, candidate)
+
+    return min(candidates, key=score)
